guide: DraftDiff(subject, segments, recipients?) — an email the agent drafted, shown as a diff against the user's edits, for them to approve, keep editing or discard; nothing is sent without Approve. Use it for any email draft the user will approve. segments is a list of {text, change} where change is "added" or "removed" (omit it for text that stays). Events: approve_send {subject, body, recipients} with body = the final text (unchanged and added, no removed); keep_editing {}; discard_draft {}. Example: mail = DraftDiff("Weekly report", [{text: "Hi team, here is the report. "}, {text: "Numbers are low.", change: "removed"}, {text: "Revenue is up 8%.", change: "added"}], ["Ananya Reddy", "Vikram Patel"])

DraftDiff.description: An email draft as a diff: removed text struck through, added text underlined; the user approves, keeps editing or discards it.

segments.description: The body in order, split into pieces. Removed pieces are shown but not sent.

text.description: A piece of the body. Keep the spaces and line breaks in it.

change.description: "added" for new text, "removed" for text to delete. Omit it for text that stays.

recipients.description: Names of the people it goes to. Shows a "To N people" badge.
